column.text: Bitcoin is testing immediate resistance near sixty-four thousand three hundred dollars while the broader market navigates a regime of risk-off caution despite Fears and Greed sitting at twenty-seven. The dominant signal emerging from our desk read reveals a divergence between rising price action on neutral funding rates, specifically a one point two seven long-to-short ratio, suggesting an impending squeeze rather than exhaustion. We are witnessing short covering pressure where liquidation data shows thirteen point eight million in shorts being wiped out versus only five point eight million longs hit, yet open interest remains flat indicating movement is driven by leverage unwinding not fresh institutional accumulation. Stablecoin dry powder totaling two hundred fifty-nine billion dollars sits ready to deploy if momentum shifts but current technicals require real proof of continuation like a reclaim of the twenty-day moving average or negative funding squeeze before most breakout longs can justify their entries. The tape remains down-trending so counter-trend buying is only warranted as high-conviction reversals at clear exhaustion points with specific catalysts rather than reflexive dip buys. Headlines add noise to this picture ranging from a Lookonlook report of a trader profiting four hundred forty-eight thousand dollars by monitoring Binance listings to news that Ethereum proposal EIP eight three six one aims to burn validator rewards capping net yield down to one point two percent over eighteen months.
